title: fix(plugin-tree): the object tree reads its loading and empty text from the bundle
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNSK5n9VEENdLx47urr6NTn)_

Fixes #28892

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:对象树(`object-tree`,例如 Setup › 业务单元的默认树视图)的加载态和空态不再写死英文，改读语言包的 `common.loading` / `common.noData`。中文界面显示「加载中…」和「暂无数据」;英文空态从 `No records` 变为 `No data`。
- **为什么改**:中文界面打开业务单元时，加载中和无数据都显示英文，和整页中文不一致。repeater / record-picker 已在 objectui#12910 改读同一对键，树渲染器漏了。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改两行文案和 4 个测试里的英文字面，没有新键、没有元数据变化。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx`(`TREE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` 和两处占位)、`ui/packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.placeholderI18n.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.placeholderI18n.test.tsx`,预期 1 个文件、4 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ObjectTree` draws its loading line with `t('common.loading')` and its empty line with `t('common.noData')`, through the `useTreeTranslation` hook it already calls for the overlay heading. Before, both were the English literals `Loading…` and `No records`.
- The two keys join `TREE_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, so a provider-less host still reads English (`Loading…`, `No data`).
- The English empty line changes from `No records` to `No data`, the `en` pack's value for `common.noData`. That is the same move objectui#12910 made for the record picker.
- `ui/packages/i18n` is untouched. Both keys already exist in all ten packs.

## Tests

- **New: `ObjectTree.placeholderI18n.test.tsx`, 4 cases.** Under a zh provider, a pending read draws 加载中… and an empty result draws 暂无数据, with no English beside them. Under en, the same states draw `Loading…` and `No data`.
- **Four existing files read `No data` instead of `No records`:** `ObjectTree.contractEnvelope-6839`, `ObjectTree.dataArmSpecRow-8348`, `ObjectTree.expandedDerived-8666` and `__tests__/objectTreeInputs-11168`. They render without a provider, so they read the defaults table.

## Acceptance notes

- **Acceptance 1:** done; see What changes.
- **Acceptance 2 (a declared emptyText still wins): holds, because there is no declared key on the tree path.** `ComponentPropsMap['object-tree']` (`ObjectTreePropsSchema`) declares no `emptyText` or `emptyState`, and plugin-tree reads none. This PR takes no authored text away.
- **The view-level `emptyState` is not drawn for tree views, before or after this PR.** `ListView` draws `ListEmptyState` from the view's `emptyState` only for the grid and gallery layouts, and hands a tree view's empty set to `ObjectTree`. That is a separate gap in `ListView.tsx`, outside this card's surface. The seat files it.
- **Acceptance 3:** done; see Tests.
- The error line (`Failed to load tree: …`) is still English. It is outside this card.

## Verification

All readings are at head `636a312d` (base `origin/main` `9a9823d9`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-tree/`: Test Files 26 passed (26), Tests 172 passed (172). The lock printed `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-tree run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- The prerequisite build was `turbo run build` for the plugin-tree dependency closure plus formula, sdui-parser, lint and client: 48 of 48 tasks.
</details>

Each leg ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which reported the anchor count 1 to 0 and a blob change, then restored the file to the HEAD blob with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Loading line put back to the literal `Loading…`: `draws the zh loading line while its read is pending` red, 1 failed and 3 passed.
- Empty line put back to the literal `No records`: `draws the zh empty line for an empty result` and `draws the en empty line for an empty result` red, 2 failed and 2 passed.
</details>
